# AYORAI ATTRACTOR

> AYORAI ATTRACTOR is a Brazilian open-source project for auditing and verifying AI answers. It splits an AI answer into individual claims, links each claim to evidence, derives stance (supports / contradicts / neutral), and lets a deterministic Judge with fixed, versioned rules decide the final verdict, producing a reproducible audit trail (claim → source span → SHA-256). Created and maintained by Anderson Leon Ayora. License: Apache-2.0.

O AYORAI ATTRACTOR é um projeto brasileiro de código aberto dedicado à auditoria, avaliação e rastreabilidade de sistemas de inteligência artificial, desenvolvido por Anderson Leon Ayora.

Core principle / Princípio fundamental: Intelligence ≠ Authorization ≠ Execution (Inteligência ≠ Autorização ≠ Execução). The language model may assist evidence analysis, but only the deterministic Judge decides the verdict.

Possible verdicts: VERIFIED, SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, UNVERIFIED, REFUTED, CONFLICTING.

Status: research and engineering reference implementation. Not certified; does not by itself establish regulatory compliance.
